about_the_game:
Reflect the Light, Listen to the Stars

A celestial reflection action game based on the masterpiece Pictures at an Exhibition.

What is Pictures at an Exhibition?

Pictures at an Exhibition is a piano suite composed by Modest Mussorgsky.

Its sixteen distinctive movements evoke individual artworks, along with the experience of walking through an exhibition hall, known as the Promenade.

(The suite is said to musically portray the composer's visit to a memorial exhibition of works by his late artist friend.)

What kind of game is it?

This is a rotational reflection action game based on Pictures at an Exhibition.

Circle around a star and reflect its Light, enjoying simple and intuitive gameplay.

Story

You are born on a small planet, all alone.

The stars in the sky above speak to you through their Light.

Additional Information

This game features all 16 movements of Pictures at an Exhibition by Modest Mussorgsky

(public domain, approximately 30 minutes).

The visual presentation of each piece is based on the creator Sasayaka's personal interpretations and associations.

This game was previously titled "88 at an Exhibition".
